inspiration.observed_pattern: A rounded Euclidean distance over POWER and SQRT produces an approximate numeric result whose wire metadata must remain DOUBLE.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one independently authored scalar distance expression, removing table access, pair generation, and MIN while preserving the ROUND-over-SQRT metadata contract.

fixture_notes: The fixed 3-4-5 triangle isolates ROUND's approximate numeric result type after SQRT and POWER evaluation.
determinism_notes: All numeric literals are fixed; the scalar query has no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections.
